verification.method: scripts/verify/saudi-arabia.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank, share, growth, density, land area; 20 times the 1950 total; growth every projected year, about double by 2100
Males per 100 females 1950/2026/2100; sixth highest among countries over 1 million, behind Qatar, UAE, Oman, Bahrain, Kuwait
Only declines 2017 and 2018, each with net outflow above 900 thousand; 2022 largest gain with net inflow near 1 million; natural increase over four times net migration
Births and deaths 2026; fertility 1970 and now, below 2.1 from 2034 (projection); median age
Fourth in Western Asia after Turkey, Iraq, Yemen; rank 2100; urban share; title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 62 of 62 checks match
UN WUP 2025 original file WUP2025-F15-National-Definitions_percPop_by_category.xlsx (SHA-256 5fdc43a9…, downloaded 2026-11-25); licence CC BY 3.0 IGO stated in the file
verification.result: All figures match. Comparisons name the size group used (countries over 1, 5 or 50 million) so small territories do not change the ranking. The page explains no causes the UN data do not show. No image alt text on the page (the flag and charts carry aria-labels).
